en.app_short_desc: Master your income, expenses, multi-currency wallets, smart budgets, and loans effortlessly.
en.hero_title: Take Full Control of Your Financial Future
en.hero_subtitle: Track income, manage multiple wallets in any global currency, set intelligent budgets, crush savings goals, and get automated smart money insights.
en.feat_title: Fintech Precision Built for Everyday Life
en.feat_subtitle: Everything you need to master cash flow, eliminate debt, and build wealth with ease.
en.feat_wallets_desc: Cash, Bank Accounts, Cards, bKash, Nagad, and Custom Wallets with seamless real-time transfers.
en.feat_insights_desc: Automated rule-based detection for spending spikes, budget overruns, and goal milestone projections.
en.feat_budgets_desc: Category-level limits with early warning alerts before you overspend.
en.feat_goals_desc: Track targets, log contributions with confetti celebrations, and see exact completion timelines.
en.feat_loans_desc: Keep crystal-clear records of money you owe and money owed to you with due-date reminders.
en.feat_security_desc: Strict user data isolation, encrypted credentials, and secure session management.
en.pricing_subtitle: Start free forever or unlock unlimited financial power with Hishab Khata PRO.
en.plan_pro_feat4: Export Data to PDF, Excel (XLSX) & CSV
en.faq_q1: What makes Hishab Khata different from traditional spreadsheets?
en.faq_a1: Hishab Khata gives you live multi-wallet balance tracking, automated budget warnings, real multi-currency support, debt schedules, and rule-based smart insights in over 15 languages.
en.faq_a2: Yes. All data is protected with strict user-level isolation, encrypted password hashing, and zero unauthorized third-party sharing.
en.faq_q3: Can I use Hishab Khata in my native language?
en.faq_a3: Absolutely! We support English, Bengali (বাংলা), Arabic (العربية with full RTL), Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, and more.
en.cta_subtitle: Join thousands of individuals and small entrepreneurs managing their wealth effortlessly.
en.dash_no_recent_tx: No transactions recorded yet. Click 'Add Income' or 'Add Expense' to get started!
en.tx_subtitle: Record, monitor, and search your entire cash flow history across all wallets.
en.wallets_subtitle: Keep track of cash, bank accounts, debit/credit cards, and digital mobile wallets.
en.budgets_subtitle: Set spending caps per category to stay financially disciplined and avoid overspending.
en.goals_subtitle: Set financial targets, allocate funds, and celebrate every milestone achieved.
en.loans_subtitle: Maintain a clean record of money you borrowed or lent to friends, family, or institutions.
en.insights_subtitle: Intelligent analytics and rule-based detections to help you make smarter financial decisions.
en.ai_advisor_desc: Ask any financial question or request deep personalized spending analysis.
en.ai_placeholder: e.g., How can I reduce my dining expenses and save ৳5,000 more this month?
en.reports_subtitle: Explore deep historical reports, trends, and download professional financial statements.
en.settings_subtitle: Manage your personal profile, localization preferences, theme, and security.
en.admin_subtitle: Global management console for users, system categories, languages, and platform health.
en.admin_users_search: Search by name, email, or role...
en.auth_login_subtitle: Sign in to access your Hishab Khata dashboard.
en.auth_register_subtitle: Join thousands of users organizing their money globally.
en.auth_logout_confirm: Are you sure you want to log out?
en.legal_disclaimer: Hishab Khata is an intelligent financial tracking and personal budgeting tool designed for individual and family cashflow organization. It does not constitute professional investment or tax advice.

suggestions.title: SMS Automatic Transaction Parsing for bKash & Nagad
suggestions.description: It would be amazing if the mobile PWA can auto-read or paste bKash/Nagad cash in & out transaction SMS to record entries automatically with 1 click!
suggestions.adminReply: Great idea! We are actively implementing smart SMS parser regex for all Bangladeshi MFS in the next update. Thank you!
